case_number: Criminal Appeal No. 82 of 2022 (arising out of SLP (Crl.) No. 7129 of 2021)
summary: Dispute over custody of minor child, born in USA, detained in India beyond agreed travel period. Respondent sought habeas corpus in Punjab and Haryana High Court after U.S. Circuit Court granted him interim custody. High Court directed return of child to USA or handover of custody; appeal raised medical needs, parental fitness, and welfare. Supreme Court upheld child's return to USA for ongoing custody proceedings, emphasizing comity and existing foreign orders.
legal_provisions_cited: Yashita Sahu v. State of Rajasthan
Smt. Surinder Kaur Sandhu v. Harbax Singh Sandhu
Elizabeth Dinshaw (Mrs.) v. Arvand M. Dinshaw and Another
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; upheld High Court's direction for return of child to USA or handover of custody to respondent, preserving rights for U.S. court to decide final custody.
